description: Ministry of Buddasasana,Cultural and Religious Affairs - Wagegoda Rankothmalu Purana Rajamaha Viharaya Publishing as a Sacred Places
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with the declaration of a specific land area (19.9379 hectares) as a sacred area for the Historical Rankothmalu Purana Rajamaha Viharaya. It includes detailed land boundaries, survey information, and specific location details (villages, tracing numbers, block numbers). While it mentions government officials (President and Minister), the core content is about land designation and protection, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
